# AFX DEX Developer Documentation

AFX DEX is a decentralized perpetuals exchange with an AI-agent-friendly API surface.

## Primary Docs

- Public API Reference: https://afx-docs.gitbook.io/afx/api-reference
- Source overview: /index.md
- Quick start: /quickstart.md
- Python SDK: /sdk.md
- Signing: /signing.md
- Exchange API: /openapi/exchange.yaml
- Info API: /openapi/info.yaml
- WebSocket API: /openapi/websocket.yaml

## Machine-Readable Artifacts

- Combined REST OpenAPI: /artifacts/openapi.json
- Info OpenAPI: /artifacts/openapi-info.json
- Exchange OpenAPI: /artifacts/openapi-exchange.json
- WebSocket AsyncAPI: /artifacts/asyncapi.json
- Signed action envelope schema: /artifacts/schemas/signed-action-envelope.schema.json
- Signed action payload schemas: /artifacts/schemas/signed-actions.schema.json
